subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field at centre of circular loop of radius R carrying current I
explain: Standard result from Biot-Savart law for full circular loop at its centre.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field inside a long solenoid of n turns per unit length
explain: Ampere's law gives uniform field μ₀nI inside an ideal infinite solenoid.

subject: Physics
prompt: Force per unit length between two parallel wires carrying I₁, I₂ separated by d
explain: Derived from field of one wire times force on the other; defines the ampere.

subject: Physics
prompt: Biot-Savart law: field dB due to current element Idl at distance r
explain: Biot-Savart: dB ∝ Idl×r̂/r²; magnitude involves sinθ between dl and r.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field due to infinite straight wire at perpendicular distance r
explain: Ampere's law over circular path of radius r gives B = μ₀I/2πr.

subject: Physics
prompt: Torque on a current loop of area A, N turns in field B at angle θ to B
explain: Torque τ = m×B; |τ| = NIA·B sinθ where θ is angle between m and B.

subject: Physics
prompt: Radius of circular motion of charge q, mass m in magnetic field B
explain: Lorentz force provides centripetal force: qvB = mv²/r ⟹ r = mv/qB.

subject: Physics
prompt: Time period of circular motion of charge in magnetic field (cyclotron period)
explain: T = 2πr/v = 2πm/qB; independent of speed—key cyclotron principle.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic moment of a current loop of area A carrying current I
explain: Magnetic moment m = NIA for N turns; direction by right-hand rule.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which direction does force on a current-carrying conductor in B follow?
explain: Force F = IL×B direction given by Fleming's left-hand rule (motor rule).

subject: Physics
prompt: Ampere's circuital law statement (integral form)
explain: Ampere's law: line integral of B around closed loop equals μ₀ times enclosed current.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field at the end (on axis) of a semi-infinite solenoid
explain: At the open end of a solenoid, field is exactly half that inside: μ₀nI/2.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field on axis of circular loop at distance x from centre
explain: Standard axial field result; reduces to μ₀I/2R at x=0.

subject: Physics
prompt: SI unit of magnetic moment
explain: Magnetic moment m = IA; units = ampere × metre² = A·m².

subject: Physics
prompt: Two parallel currents in same direction
explain: Same-direction currents attract; opposite-direction currents repel (Ampere's force law).

subject: Physics
prompt: Lorentz force on charge q moving with velocity v in fields E and B
explain: Total Lorentz force includes both electric and magnetic components.

subject: Physics
prompt: Sensitivity of a moving coil galvanometer depends on
explain: Current sensitivity = θ/I = NBA/k; high N, B, A and low spring constant k give high sensitivity.

subject: Physics
prompt: To convert a galvanometer to ammeter, connect a shunt S in
explain: Shunt (small resistance) in parallel diverts most current, protecting the galvanometer.

subject: Physics
prompt: To convert a galvanometer to voltmeter, connect high resistance R in
explain: High series resistance limits current so full-scale deflection occurs at desired voltage.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field inside a toroid of N turns, radius R, carrying current I
explain: Ampere's law for toroid: B·2πR = μ₀NI ⟹ B = μ₀NI/2πR inside core.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field outside an ideal toroid is
explain: Ampere's law: enclosed current is zero outside toroid, so B = 0 outside.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dimension of magnetic field B
explain: B = F/qv; [B] = kg/(A·s²) = M T⁻² A⁻¹ (note: no L in denominator for Tesla).

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field at centre of a semicircular arc of radius R carrying current I
explain: Semicircle contributes half of full circle: B = (1/2)·μ₀I/2R = μ₀I/4R.

subject: Physics
prompt: Work done by magnetic force on a moving charge is always
explain: Magnetic force F = qv×B is always ⊥ to v, so no work is done on the charge.

subject: Physics
prompt: Pitch of helical path of charge in magnetic field
explain: Pitch = component of v along B × time period = v cosθ × (2πm/qB).

subject: Physics
prompt: Gyromagnetic ratio (orbital) for an electron is
explain: Ratio of orbital magnetic moment to orbital angular momentum = e/2mₑ for electron.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field due to a finite straight wire at perp. distance r (angle α, β)
explain: For a finite wire, B = μ₀I(sinα+sinβ)/4πr where α,β are angles subtended at point.

subject: Physics
prompt: Current sensitivity of a galvanometer is defined as
explain: Current sensitivity = θ/I = NBA/k; greater NBA or smaller k gives higher sensitivity.

subject: Physics
prompt: A charge moving parallel to B experiences magnetic force equal to
explain: θ = 0° → sinθ = 0 → F = 0; charge moves undeflected parallel to field.

subject: Physics
prompt: SI unit of magnetic flux Φ is
explain: Magnetic flux Φ = B·A; SI unit is Weber (Wb) = T·m².

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field between two infinite parallel sheets carrying surface current K (antiparallel):
explain: Fields add between sheets (antiparallel currents) giving B = μ₀K; cancel outside.

subject: Physics
prompt: The force on a charge q at rest in a magnetic field B is
explain: Magnetic force F = qv×B; v = 0 → F = 0; rest charge feels no magnetic force.

subject: Physics
prompt: Voltage sensitivity of galvanometer vs current sensitivity when resistance increases:
explain: Voltage sensitivity = current sensitivity/G; increasing G can reduce voltage sensitivity.

subject: Physics
prompt: Radius of circular path of charged particle in B depends on:
explain: r = mv/qB = p/qB; radius is directly proportional to momentum of the particle.

subject: Physics
prompt: Cyclotron frequency (ν) of a charged particle in magnetic field B is
explain: Cyclotron frequency ν = qB/2πm; independent of speed and radius of the orbit.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field at centre of a circular arc of angle φ (radians) and radius R:
explain: For arc of angle φ: B = μ₀Iφ/4πR; full circle φ=2π gives B = μ₀I/2R.

subject: Physics
prompt: In a moving coil galvanometer, the radial magnetic field ensures
options: Linear scale only at small angles
explain: Radial field keeps plane of coil always parallel to B, so torque = NIAB for all θ.

subject: Physics
prompt: The shunt resistance S to convert galvanometer (Ig, G) to ammeter for current I:
explain: Voltage across shunt = voltage across G: (I−Ig)S = IgG → S = IgG/(I−Ig).

subject: Physics
prompt: Two anti-parallel currents in nearby wires exert what force on each other?
explain: Opposite (antiparallel) currents repel each other; parallel currents attract.

subject: Physics
prompt: The net magnetic force on a closed current loop in a uniform magnetic field is
explain: In uniform B, forces on opposite sides cancel; net force = 0, only net torque acts.

subject: Physics
prompt: Potential energy of a magnetic dipole m in field B is
explain: U = −m⃗·B⃗ = −mBcosθ; minimum at θ=0 (stable) and maximum at θ=180° (unstable).

subject: Physics
prompt: Ampere (SI base unit) is now defined using:
explain: Since 2019 SI revision, Ampere is defined by fixing e = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C exactly.

subject: Physics
prompt: Which quantity is conserved when a charged particle moves in a static magnetic field?
explain: Magnetic force ⊥ velocity → no work done → kinetic energy (speed) remains constant.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field on axis of a solenoid at its end compared to centre is
explain: At end of solenoid, only half the solid angle contributes; B_end = μ₀nI/2.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a toroid, magnetic field in the region outside (r > outer radius) is:
explain: Net current enclosed by any outer Amperian loop is zero → B = 0 outside toroid.

subject: Physics
prompt: The angle of dip at the magnetic equator of Earth is
explain: At magnetic equator, field is horizontal; vertical component = 0, so dip angle = 0°.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dimension of permeability of free space μ₀ is
explain: From B = μ₀I/2πr: [μ₀] = [B·L/I] = [MT⁻²A⁻¹·m/A] = MLT⁻²A⁻².

subject: Physics
prompt: The series resistance R to convert galvanometer G to voltmeter for range V:
explain: Full-scale deflection: V = Ig(G + R) → R = V/Ig − G; R is in series with G.

subject: Physics
prompt: Magnetic field at centre of a square loop of side a carrying current I
explain: Each side contributes μ₀I/(2πa)·(1/√2)·2; summing 4 sides gives 2√2μ₀I/(πa).

subject: Physics
prompt: Force on a current-carrying conductor of length L in field B at angle θ is
explain: F = I(L×B); magnitude is BIL sinθ, where θ is angle between L and B.
